1445-3899-4871-8347.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
1445-3899-4871-8347.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Sela triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

2645-3430-4717-7014.easyPrerequisites: North Pole Patrol doesn't have summoning sickness.
2645-3430-4717-7014.description:
Activate City of Traitors by tapping it, adding six {C} due to Nyxbloom Ancient.
Activate North Pole Patrol by tapping it, untapping City of Traitors
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping North Pole Patrol.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

1879-2023-4518-6006.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying its mana cost.
Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Kor Skyfisher enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Kor Skyfisher and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

3750-8190.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five creatures with different powers.

34-147-2438.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
34-147-2438.description:
Cast Footsteps of the Goryo by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Footsteps of the Goryo.
Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, putting a +1/+1 counter on Carrion Feeder.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Footsteps of the Goryo
Resolve the Footsteps of the Goryo copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

3756-5256-6871-7115--44.description:
Cast the artifact by paying {0}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Izzet Boilerworks.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Izzet Boilerworks.
When Izzet Boilerworks dies, Toph, Hardheaded Teach triggers, returning Izzet Boilerworks from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Izzet Boilerworks enters, it triggers, returning the artifact cast in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand, as it's a land due to Toph, the First Metalbender.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability
Repeat.

803-997-3413.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing any other creature.
When the creature dies as a Human due to Arcane Adaptation, Xathrid Necromancer triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

206-2034-6723-6970-7850.description:
Cast Abby from the command zone by paying {1}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
Abby triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Fungus Zombie creature tokens named Cordyceps Infected equal to the amount of mana spent to cast it.
When Abby enters under an opponent's control, Mirror of Life Trapping triggers, exiling Abby.
Choose to return Abby from exile to the command zone.
Activate two Codryceps Infected tokens by tapping them, adding {R}{G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Cordyceps Infected token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat step 6 until you have enough mana to cast Abby.
Repeat from step 1.

2976-4094-5702.easyPrerequisites:
At least two loyalty counters on Kaya.
You control a Forest that enters the battlefield untapped.
2976-4094-5702.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Animate a Forest that enters untapped using Animate Land
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated Forest.
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
When the Forest tokens enter, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the Forest tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
Repeat from step 5.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-2665-5399.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-2665-5399.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Pirated Copy and Progenitor Mimic each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Pirated Copy trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Progenitor Mimic trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-2665-5399.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

1594-2350-2781-6867.description:
Cast Appa either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {W}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Felidar Guardian with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Felidar Guardian from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Felidar Guardian enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

1806-2060-5686-7367-7741.description:
Activate Eternal Scourge's scavenge ability, granted to it by Young Deathclaws, by paying {3} and exiling Eternal Scourge from your graveyard, putting six +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler due to Shang-Chi.
Activate Crystalline Crawler six times by removing six +1/+1 counters from it, adding {6}.
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Eternal Scourge.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

3967-6972-7726.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Virtuous Variant.
When Virtuous Variant dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Virtuous Variant enters, it triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

719-4302-6798.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
719-4302-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Bishop of Wings' second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
When the Spirit token enters the battlefield as an Angel due to Xenograft, Bishop of Wings' first ability triggers, causing you to gain 4 life.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

3490-4659-6752-6996.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3490-4659-6752-6996.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Haliya triggers, causing you to gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers. Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the The Destined White Mage trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

1806-2060-2292-4772-7367.description:
Activate Eternal Scourge's scavenge ability, granted to it by Young Deathclaws, by paying {3} and exiling Eternal Scourge from your graveyard, putting six +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler due to Doubling Season.
Activate Crystalline Crawler six times by removing six +1/+1 counters from it, adding {6}.
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Eternal Scourge.
Repeat.

2440-7082-7109-7296.description:
Cast Trusty Boomerang by paying {1}.
When Trusty Boomerang enters, Sokka and Suki's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token.
When the Ally enters, Sokka's first ability and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding {C} for each Ally you control.
Resolve the Sokka trigger, attaching Trusty Boomerang to the Ally token.
Activate the Ally by paying {1} and tapping it, tapping a creature and returning Trusty Boomerang from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2308-3330-4050-4871.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain any amount of life.
2308-3330-4050-4871.description:
Gain any amount of life.
Trudge Garden triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a 4/4 Fungus Beast creature token.
When the Fungus Beast enters, Leyline of Vitality triggers.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Fungus Beast, adding {1}.
When the Fungus Beast dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Holding priority, activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Resolve the Leyline of Vitality trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

283-890-5089-5295.description:
Activate Palladium Myr by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Karn's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, causing Thousand-Year Elixir to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Illusionist's Bracers' equip ability by paying {3}, attaching it to Thousand-Year Elixir.
Activate Thousand-Year Elixir by paying {1} and tapping it, targeting itself.
Illusionist's Bracers triggers, copying Thousand-Year Elixir's abillity, targeting Palladium Myr.
Resolve both Thousand-Year Elixir abilities, untapping it and Palladium Myr.
Activate Palladium Myr by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 4.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

1636-4415-6972.notablePrerequisites: You are able to pay to cast Stonecloaker using any combination of mana-producing creatures and/or creatures that can reduce its cost using convoke.
1636-4415-6972.description:
Cast Stonecloaker by paying its mana cost reduced by the number of creatures you can tap while casting it.
When Stonecloaker enters, it and Intruder Alarm trigger.
Resolve the Stonecloaker trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
1636-4415-6972.notes: If you control mana-producing creatures, you can tap those creatures for mana instead of tapping them using the convoke ability.

2099-5795-6871-6879.description:
Cast Barkform Harvester by paying {3}.
When Barkform Harvester enters, Haru triggers, targeting Barkform Harvester as it is a land due to Toph.
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing Barkform Harvester.
When Barkform Harvester dies, Haru triggers, returning Barkform Harvester from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Barkform Harvester enters, Haru triggers, targeting Barkform Harvester as it is a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Sarcatog ability.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with a film counter on it

57-4846-6791-6924.notablePrerequisites: You control any number of permanents that enter untapped and that can collectively tap to produce at least {4}{R}.
57-4846-6791-6924.description:
Activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {4}{R}.
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Holding priority, activate Peter Parker's Camera by paying {2}, tapping and removing a film counter from it, copying Feldon's ability targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1376-1978-2392.notablePrerequisites: There are at least three Elves on the battlefield.
1376-1978-2392.description:
Cause Priest of Titania to become an artifact using Silverskin Armor.
Activate Priest of Titania by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Priest of Titania.
Repeat from step 2.

997-2060-2946-6701.easyPrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
997-2060-2946-6701.description:
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript is sacrificed, Szarel triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters equal to Szarel's power on Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate Crystalline Crawler twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{B}.
Repeat.
997-2060-2946-6701.notes: This combo can put infinite +1/+1 counters on each creature you control except Szarel so long as its power is greater than the mana needed to activate the creature's ability from your graveyard.

252-4871-5295.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature and have a way to cause that creature to die.
252-4871-5295.description:
Kill any other creature you control.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token that enters the battlefield as a 7/7 Dinosaur due to Displaced Dinosaurs.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat from step 2.

2933-4013-4785-5798.description:
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Drowner of Hope.
When Drowner of Hope enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating two 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature tokens.
Activate the Eldrazi Scions by tapping them, adding {2}.
Activate an Eldrazi Scion by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite tapped Eldrazi Scion tokens, you may sacrifice them for infinite {C}, and then forego tapping or sacrificing subsequent Eldrazi Scions.

565-1858-6556--118.notablePrerequisites:
You control an animated land without summoning sickness that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least {U}.
You control a white permanent.
565-1858-6556--118.description:
Activate an animated land by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast View from Above by paying {U}, targeting the animated land.
Orvar triggers, creating a token copy of the animated land that is not a creature.
Resolve View from Above, returning it to your hand.
Activate the land token by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Repeat from step 2.

1497-2092-5217-6006.description:
Activate Order of Whiteclay by tapping it, adding {W}.
Activate Wild Cantor by sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Activate Order of Whiteclay by paying {W}{W} and untapping it, returning Wild Cantor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1339-2558-3698-6666.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
1339-2558-3698-6666.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
When the Insect enters the battlefield, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Insect.
When Sword of the Meek enters the battlefield, Grinding Station and Rook Turret triggers.
Resolve the Grinding Station trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Resolve the Rook Turret trigger, causing you to loot.
Repeat from step 2.

224-1362-6628.description:
Activate PuPu UFO by tapping it, putting Oboro from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Oboro enters the battlefield, Retreat to Coralhelm triggers, untapping PuPu UFO.
Activate Oboro's first ability by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Oboro's second ability by paying {1}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2653-5412-5531-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have at least two lands between the battlefield and your graveyard.
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn
2653-5412-5531-5702.description:
Play any land.
When the land enters the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers.
Holding priority, activate Coastal Hornclaw by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 3 until you control no lands.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Lumra.
Put the token Lumra into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Lumra token's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, causing you to mill four cards and returning all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the lands enter the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko and Nissa trigger that many times.
Resolve all Nissa triggers, adding {G} for each trigger.
Resolve all but one Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating that many 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

1322-3259-6438.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1322-3259-6438.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Elsha, triggering Breath of Fury and Elsha.
Resolve the Elsha trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

2043-4659-5747.description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating a copy of Simulacrum Synthesizer that is a 1/1 Construct.
When the Simulacrum Synthesizer token enters the battlefield, its first ability and each other SImulacrum Synthesizer you control's second abilities trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, causing you to scry 2.
Resolve the remaining triggers, creating a 0/0 Construct artifact creature token for each trigger resolved this way.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing a 0/0 Construct, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat step 5 for each other 0/0 Construct you control, if applicable.
Repeat from step 1.
2043-4659-5747.notes: Once you have three Simulacrum Synthesizer tokens, this combo will begin to break even and eventually net additional tokens and mana.

uses.exileCardState: with a takeover counter on it

2092-3719-3908-5326.notablePrerequisites: Spark Double and Agatha of the Vile Cauldron each have a power of at least 2.
2092-3719-3908-5326.description:
Cast The Master by paying {U}{B}.
When The Master enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice Spark Double and create at least two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate The Master by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning Spark Double from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of The Master, which causes the Spark Double to be a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
When Spark Double enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice The Master and create two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Spark Double by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning The Master from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
Repeat from step 2.

719-1724-4304.description:
Cast Sekki by paying {5}{G}{G}{G}.
Sekki enters the battlefield as a Bear due to Xenograft.
Ayula triggers, causing Sekki to fight a creature you don't control.
Sekki removes a number of +1/+1 counters from it equal to the damage it would've been dealt and creates that many 1/1 Spirit creature tokens, which are Bears due to Xenograft.
When the Spirit Bear(s) enter the battlefield, Ayula triggers that many times.
If Sekki is on the battlefield, resolve an Ayula trigger, causing Sekki to fight a creature you don't control, and then repeat from step 3.
If Sekki is not on the battlefield, activate Sekki by sacrificing eight Spirits, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as a Bear with eight +1/+1 counters on it due to Xenograft.
If Sekki entered the battlefield, Ayula triggers, causing Sekki to fight a creature you don't control.
Repeat from step 3.
719-1724-4304.notes: You may repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under your control.

1479-3147-3908.description:
Play Azorius Chancery.
Kodama of the East Tree, Spark Double, and Azorius Chancery trigger.
Resolve the Spark Double trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Azorius Chancery trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting Azorius Chancery onto the battlefield.
Spark Double and Azorius Chancery trigger.
Resolve the Azorius Chancery trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the Spark Double token's trigger, putting Azorius Chancery onto the battlefield.
Kodama of the East Tree and Azorius Chancery trigger.
Repeat from step 5.

2178-3113-5136.notablePrerequisites:
All Equipments and/or Auras attached to the same creature.
That creature does not have summoning sickness.
2178-3113-5136.description:
Activate the creature by tapping it, dealing damage to an opponent's creature.
The opponent's creature dies due to deathtouch, triggering the second ability granted by Thornbite Staff, untapping your creature.
Repeat until all opponents' creatures die.
Repeat each time a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

539-5282.description:
Cast Wormfang Newt by paying {1}{U}.
When Wormfang Newt enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Wormfang Newt.
When Wormfang Newt leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning itself from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

2211-2415-4508.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Treasure token.
Captain's Hook attached to Havoc Jester.
2211-2415-4508.description:
Activate a Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to any opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat.

2316-2557-4050.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two Goblins.
2316-2557-4050.description:
Activate Goblin Warrens by paying {2}{R} and sacrificing two Goblins, creating six 1/1 Goblin creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing three Goblins, adding {2}{R}.
Repeat.

3536-4934-5078.description:
Declare Cheering Fanatic as an attacker. When it triggers, choose to name "Sensei's Divining Top".
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Amareth triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Amareth trigger, causing you to look at the top card of your library, which will be Sensei's Divining Top, and put it into your hand.
Repeat from step 2

1987-2510-3227-3941.notablePrerequisites: Any instant exiled by Semblance Anvil.
1987-2510-3227-3941.description:
Activate Coveted Jewel by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Coveted Jewel and Scrivener, blinking them.
When Scrivener enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
When Coveted Jewel enters the battlefield, draw three cards.
Repeat.
